clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity's War Quarter, Aelthalyste trains Forsaken priests in the power of Shadow. She guides their spiritual discipline and sends troll acolytes to their own elders in Orgrimmar.

Aelthalyste trains Forsaken priests in the power of Shadow. While many priests across Azeroth revere the Holy Light, her students have turned from it. She rose as an incorporeal banshee and shares the spectral agony and relentless resolve of Sylvanas Windrunner's followers. From her chamber in the Undercity's War Quarter, she calls aspiring priests from distant outposts to master their darker arts. She teaches them to harness suffering as a weapon.

Aelthalyste respects the spiritual traditions of other Horde practitioners. She sends troll initiates away from her shadow teachings, directing them across the sea to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar, where they can learn Darkspear spiritualism. Her deference lets Horde spellcasters develop within their own traditions and strengthens ties between Kalimdor and Lordaeron.
